audit.whatIsWrong: The full chart was a blanket "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer and packet chart read Skill/Yone/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Yone/Yone. Four rows rendered two answers.
audit.why: Yone's level-2 spike (4-second Mortal Steel plus melee stats), your level-6 point-click suppression, and his first-item all-in tempo off a 13-second Soul Unbound are all real swings; the page was flattening them.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4, 5 and 6 moved onto the content layer, with whys rewritten wherever the verdict changed.

audit.why: Yone spikes at 2, at his first item, and as Soul Unbound falls from 22s to 10s; Fate Sealed goes 120s to 80s. Yours are Lost Chapter, level 6, and Liandry's.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound's 22s-to-10s scaling now printed where the advice needs it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Cleave was never mentioned anywhere in the matchup despite being a shield on a 14-second cooldown that changes every all-in calculation, and the cooldowns field carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: Enemy W is flagged shield at a flat 14s; his Q knocks up on every second cast, which is the CC that cancels your channel.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now names Soul Unbound 22s->10s, the 4s Q knock-up cadence, and the 14s Spirit Cleave shield.

audit.why: Soul Unbound's cooldown is the stated clock of the lane and was never printed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, report[7].t claimed TP 'doubles' with no source.
audit.why: Lint findings; bodies did not match their titles.
audit.corrected: Rewritten grounded in Yone's ranges and cooldowns.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s maxed — his burst window; survive it and punish the body it snaps back to. - Mortal Steel is 4s and every second cast knocks up. - Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s: poke it off first.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Yone wins by opening with Soul Unbound, knocking you up with the second Mortal Steel, and dragging you back in with Fate Sealed.

edits.before: Carry by subtraction — every fight starts 4v5 when your R lands; your job is the wave control that makes the fight happen on your timer.
edits.after: Carry by lockdown — Nether Grasp point-clicks through every dash he owns; make the fight happen while his 80-second Fate Sealed is down.

edits.before: You are a suppression delivery system: shield up, hold a flank, and Grasp their carry the moment the fight breathes. The visions and burn do the rest.
edits.after: Group tight with Void Shift charged: his flank beats a lone Malzahar, and your one 80-second R has to land on their carry, not on Yone's dive.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Visions plus Voidlings crash the wave while Mortal Steel only reaches 450 — shove him under tower so he never gets the freeze his all-in needs.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Fate Sealed is 80 seconds at rank 3 and pulls you straight back in — spend R to end him, never to open a fight you cannot close.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns every crashed wave into a map play. Cleanse answers the Mortal Steel knock-up that cancels your channel; Ignite closes R kills.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: Yone spikes at 2 — a 4-second Mortal Steel plus melee stats wins the first extended trade outright.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: visions melt waves AND health bars. Suppress-into-burn kills through most defensive answers.
edits.after: First item and a 13-second Soul Unbound let him force all-ins faster than your 110-second R returns.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: A fed Yone flanks past your single-target lock — group tight and hold the Q silence for the frame he presses E.

edits.before: With E Malefic Visions online you shove the wave and zone Yone off the caster minions, but respect his Q3 knock-up window: once his Mortal Steel stacks to three he can gap-close and combo, so keep your passive Void Shift up before you step into last-hit range.
edits.after: With Malefic Visions online you shove the wave and zone Yone off the caster minions, but respect the knock-up: every second Mortal Steel on a 4-second cooldown dashes him forward and knocks you airborne, so keep Void Shift charged before you step into last-hit range.

edits.before: Level 1 is even scuttle for lane priority, but at Level 2 Yone's second point in Q plus Way of the Hunter momentum lets him win the first melee trade, so give ground and don't walk up without minions between you.
edits.after: Level 1 is an even fight for priority, but at Level 2 a second point in Mortal Steel — 4 seconds, knocking up on every second cast — plus Way of the Hunter wins him the first melee trade, so give ground and keep minions between you.

edits.before: From 3 to 5 the lane neutralises — your E waveclear and shove deny him a freeze, and holding Void Shift blunts his engage — but at 6 you flip it hard: R Nether Grasp is a point-click suppress that answers his all-in and turns his dash-in into a free kill.
edits.after: From 3 to 5 the lane neutralises — Malefic Visions and the shove deny him a freeze, and Void Shift's crowd control immunity eats the Mortal Steel knock-up — but at 6 you flip it: Nether Grasp is point-click, so no dash refuses it and his commit becomes a free kill.

edits.before: Keep Void Shift charged before every trade so his Q3 or R gets partially eaten
edits.after: Keep Void Shift charged so its CC immunity eats his knock-up before you channel

notes: Full chart was blanket Skill on all seven rows against a content layer that already read Skill/Yone/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Yone/Yone; the four disagreeing rows were moved. No win[N] edits proposed — content was already correct, so pairs would have been no-ops. Two existing claims were left alone as unverifiable from the kit rather than rewritten: spikes[1] says Yone's body 'has to return to its origin point where you can re-lock him' after he ults out, and wants.foe[1] says he can use the Soul Unbound return to dodge your R. Riot's text says only that the spirit is forced back to the body; whether that breaks or dodges a suppression is not stated anywhere in the data.
